title: R' Yose ben Azzi Dabardila

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shekalim, chapter 6, halakhah 5, as printed in Bavli editions; but Hyman says the Yerushalmi reads correctly R' Yehudah ben Pazi Dabardila.[^1][^2]

notes.text: 6h 5 is a halakhah locator, not the withdrawn Mishnah reference candidate. As printed in Bavli qualifies the included Shekalim text, rather than claiming a separate Babylonian Shekalim composition. No edition is freshly checked.

Yose/Azzi differ from Yehudah/Pazi; Dabardila remains transliterated without identity/location binding. Correctly is Hyman’s judgment, not independent admission. Inherited provisional heading remains unresolved; both title abbreviations remain R'.
